title.ja: 偽小切手・過払い詐欺

short_desc.ja: 偽の小切手を送付し差額返金や商品発送を要求
short_desc.en: Send fake checks requesting refund of overpayment or goods

cultural_lever.ja: 銀行システムへの信頼・誠実な取引への期待
cultural_lever.en: Trust in banking system and expectation of honest dealings

scenario.ja: 1) 商品購入や仕事依頼 2) 過払い小切手送付 3) 差額返金要求 4) 小切手不渡り後に損失
scenario.en: 1) Purchase or job offer 2) Send overpayment check 3) Request refund difference 4) Check bounces causing loss

legal_notes.ja: 小切手詐欺は連邦犯罪
legal_notes.en: Check fraud is a federal crime

references.label: USPIS: Check Fraud
references.quote: Have you ever been asked to deposit a check or money order on behalf of someone else? Scammers use sophisticated software, commercial laser printers and scanners, and blank check stock to produce counterfeit checks. Scammers identify people looking for quick cash and offer the opportunity to make money simply by depositing some checks. You are told to deposit the check in your own account and send a portion of it to someone else.

verification.note: 'offer the opportunity to make money by depositing checks' is pretext, 'send a portion to someone else' is the request/result
